meaning:
πάλη, -ης, ἡ
(πάλλω, to sway)
wrestling, hence, generally, fight, contest: figuratively, of the spiritual combat of Christians, Eph.6:12.†

elsewhere.note: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age…
